text: Azazi is a Khajiit backpack merchant working at Pilgrimage Packs in the Tanners and Miners Hall in the Saint Olms Waistworks of Vivec City.
Baladas Dren is a Dunmer residing outside Vivec's Palace in Vivec City, in Vvardenfell, during "Divine Inquiries."
Azrath is an Orsimer member of the Agra Crun. He is found at the Fharun Stronghold.
Balir R'enar was a member of the Dark Brotherhood. He was killed during the Invasion of Wayrest alongside other Brotherhood members in Wayrest.
Bailiff Sorriel is an Altmer found in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset.
Bailiff Henlandon is an Altmer found at the northern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Azargo Long-Tale is a Khajiit Moon-singer in . He is found at Redfur Trading Post in Grahtwood.
Bahlokdaan (Dragon Language: ) is an feldgrau-green elder dragon serving under Kaalgrontiid in .
Bahtei is an Argonian member of the Root-House Tribe found at the Glade of Chimes in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Azramdu is a Khajiit civil servant residing at the Flophouse in The Stitches, Northern Elsweyr. He has no unique dialogue.
Baerter is a Redguard snake-charmer in who resides in the court of Castle Sentinel.
Balga is a Orsimer located in Southern Elsweyr at random encounters in . She is found with Fezzam and Trezzi listening to the stories of Moon-Singer Feziya-ko.
Bahlzim is a member of the Dragonguard located in Dragonguard Sanctum, Southern Elsweyr, in .
Banus Alor is a Dunmer assassin and a Speaker of the Dark Brotherhood's Black Hand.

Baradras is a Bosmer. He is a member of the Fighters Guild, and is an Apprentice in rank. He spends most of his time in the entrance hall of the Ald'ruhn Fighters Guild, talking to his fellow guild members.

Barenziah is a Dunmeri woman from Mournhold in Morrowind who lived during the Second Era. She is the daughter of the King and Queen of Mournhold, both of which perished during the Tiber War. She ruled as Queen of Mournhold and Queen of Wayrest for parts of her life. When she returned to Mournhold after the Warp in the West, she was popular among the citizens of the city.

Baragon is a Breton living in the Cloud Ruler Temple, north of Bruma in the Jerall Mountains. He serves as a member of the Blades. Baragon spends most of his time indoors in the great hall, reading his copy of Manual of Arms.
Bashuk gra-Bat is an Orsimer Commoner who resides in her house in Caldera in the West Gash on Vvardenfell, Morrowind.
Basil Ernarde is a worshipper at the shrine to the Daedric Prince Meridia. Basil gives the Hero the quest at the shrine.
Banden Indarys is a Dunmer Warrior and member of House Redoran in . He resides at Indarys Manor if the Nerevarine does not choose to build a Redoran Stronghold.
Barri is a Nord worshipper of Molag Bal who resides in Bal Ur. She can be found inside the shrine.
Barknar is a Nord pilgrim who can often be found examining the etched tablets along the 7000 Steps or at the Vilemyr Inn in the town of Ivarstead.
Barbas is Clavicus Vile's companion, a unique dog, in that is found along the road outside Falkreath.
Banning is a Breton breeder outside of Markarth in the Markarth Stables. He is revealed to be a cannibal and a member of the Coven of Namira during the quest "The Taste of Death."
Baral Sendu is a deceased Redguard found in The Stumbling Sabrecat.
Balur Salvu is a Dunmer farmer who resides in Morrowind. Balaur lives on a Farmhouse near Vivec City-Pelagaid road.
Balver Sarethan is a Dunmer pilgrim and member of Tribunal Temple, who resides in the Library of Vivec in the Temple Canton.

Balyn Omavel is a Dunmer Assassin who resides in Balmora. He is a member of the Morag Tong, though Balyn has been assassinating people without writs, something that is punishable by death. The Daedric Prince Mephala is the one who revealed his treachery to Taros Dral, and told him that it must be handled soon.
Banor Seran is a Dunmer Publican who resides in Balmora and can be found at the Council Club, and is a member of the Camonna Tong.
Baren Alen is a Dunmer who is found in the Hlaalu Vaults in Vivec. He is a member of House Hlaalu, functioning as their Treasurer.
Barusi Venim is a Dunmer Enchanter who resides in Morrowind. He is a member of House Telvanni, as an Oathman.
Bandit Plunderers are hostile enemies found throughout . They can be encountered around level 19. They are the third highest rank of Bandits, and have the same basic loadout as the other Bandits.
Bashag gro-Snagdu is an Orsimer Commoner and also a member of the Fighters Guild. Located in Foreign Quarter Plaza of Vivec City.
Basks-in-the-Sun is an Argonian who sails a vessel through Khuul and Raven Rock and provides transportation at the docks of Fort Frostmoth from Solstheim island.

This Bandit can be found lying on a bedroll in Redwater Den, coughing uncontrollably from Skooma consumption. Attempting to interact with the bandit will result in the message "This person is busy." He wears leveled light armor, leveled boots, and a 50% chance of wearing leveled bracers.
Baronk gro-Uzuk is an Orsimer Barbarian residing in Ashunartes.
Bartalus is an Imperial residing in the region of Reaper's March.
Balsa Girith is a Dunmer thief residing in Ashir-Dan. She is hostile towards Nerevarine on sight.
Basir is a Redguard farmer residing on the island of Stros M'Kai. Basir takes care of a few horses north east of Port Hunding.
Balsia is a Dunmer merchant. She sells her wares at her stall, Balsia's Bounty, outside the Screaming Mermaid in Port Hunding.
Barjot Benoit is a Breton mystic who resides in the city of Daggerfall. He can be found in the market, selling mystic items such as soul gems at at his stall Arcane Secrets, Bargain Prices.
Balzag gro-Grumush is an Orsimer guard of the Daggerfall Covenant who resides in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found outside the guard tent by the east gate.
Bashshi-ra is a Khajiit found inside Five Claws Inn and later, after the Sea Vipers have been driven away, in the Seaside Sanctuary. A written document links him with criminal activities.
Basile Fenandre is a Breton residing in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He is the hall steward for the Fighters Guild hall in the city.
Barnabe Malyne is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He has a stall in the Merchant District, where he sells his wares.
Baron Sorick is a Breton residing in Dreughside outside Wayrest in Stormhaven. He is found in the Barracks House during the quest "The Sower Reaps."
Banka is an Argonian commoner residing in the Banking District in Mournhold.
Barro Strong-Metal is a Nord found outside the Tribunal Temple in Mournhold.
Bar-Beekus is an Argonian mystic working at the Dhalmora Hall of Merchants in Dhalmora, Bal Foyen.
Barnaxi is an Argonian chef who can be found at the shore after Escape from Bleakrock, he will then move to Patience Breeds Wealth in Dhalmora, Bal Foyen.
Balvos Mothril is a Dunmer residing in The Ebony Flask inn in the city of Ebonheart, Stonefalls.
Bameli the Pure is a Dunmer prostitute working at The Ebony Flask in Ebonheart.
Baring Hammertongue is a Nord clothier and member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Kragenmoor. He can be found at the Kragenmoor Smithy, selling his wares.
Balves Andas is a Dunmer residing in the Brooding Elf Inn in Quarantine Serk.
Balynor is a traveling Dunmer merchant. He may be found on the road south of Nimalten in the Rift.
Baradin is a Nord member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their guildhall in Riften.
Barasatii is a powerful Dremora in that is found deep inside Nisin Cave. She has a chance to drop Daedra Husks, Daedra Hearts and Barasatii's Chain of Cyrodiil's Crest.
Barj the Counter is a Nord banker residing in the city of Windhelm, Eastmarch. He operates the city's bank.
Bark-Scraper is a Khajiit woodworker and member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in Elden Root, where she also sells her wares.
Baron Alard Dorell is the ruler of Northpoint and one of the three nobles trying to rule over the kingdom of Rivenspire.
Barters-with-Wit is an Argonian found in Darkwater Crossing.
Basilien Arnese is a Breton residing in the city of Wayrest, Stormhaven.
Balras Arenim is a Dunmer member of the Stonefire Cult cell that infiltrated Greenhill. He is found in the catacombs beneath, conducting strange rituals.
Baseekus is an Argonian residing in Sanguine's Demesne, Shadowfen. She is a worshipper of the Daedric prince Sanguine.
Barasil is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan found at their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Bashagorn is an Orsimer residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh.
Bash is an Orsimer found in Tumnosh Longhouse in the Tumnosh Clanhold near the Graystone Quarry. He is a member of the Tumnosh Clan.
Bardun is a Redguard bounty hunter found near the entrance to the Thukhozod's Sanctum in Wrothgar. He is married to his business partner Meram Farr.

Bargo Hammerdeath is the Orcish Arena Master of the Hammerdeath Arena. He can be found towards the northern edge of the arena, sitting on a platform with Valik and Cyrill the Sage. When spoken to, he has no unique dialogue.
Barothlas is a Bosmer member of the Falinesti Faithful found at the Falinesti Summer Site.
Banyrick Frinck is a Breton laborer residing in Koeglin Village. He can be found hiding behind a few crates on the elevated walkway by the Dock Warehouse. He has no unique dialogue.
Baron Moves-Like-a-Smoking Plume is a Dremora serving Fa-Nuit-Hen. He is returned to him after the Maelstrom Arena is successfully completed.
Banus Sedrethi is a Dunmer priest found praying in the shrine at Iliath Temple. He has no unique dialogue.
Barayin Oldrethi is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed in Fort Virak.

Baltham Greyman was a powerful Breton mage and former member of the Mages Guild. Greyman abandoned the Guild after growing tired of their practices and regulations of magicka, becoming an independent scholar before the events of . The Agent may have encountered Greyman if they decided to join the Mages Guild, a meeting that could result in a mini-quest line of its own.
Bandit Hunter is a generic Pet Ranger residing in several locations in .
Baron Volag was a Redguard and the rebel leader of the Forebears during the civil war in Hammerfell following Thassad II's death.
Barfel Hammerheart is a Nord member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Balyn Daryon is a Dunmer eating a loaf of bread in an alley in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He will occasionally be visited by Gilragaith, but he has no unique dialogue.
Baronas is a Bosmer residing in the northwestern corner of the city of Shimmerene, Summerset, where he can be found playing a game with Faldaleb, Lugurzog, and Sorr. He has no unique dialogue.
Athyn Rotheran is a Dunmer encountered in Helan Ancestral Tomb during "An Armiger's Duty."
Barzul gro-Batul, also known as The River Snake, is a disinherited member of the gro-Batul family, and father of the Bloodfall Queen, Urzoga gra-Batul.
Brother Barnabas of Thetis was a former member of the Brotherhood of Seth from Camlorn, High Rock. He is found dead in the Mines of Khuras.
Bare-Knuckle Bidandar is a Khajiit residing in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr. He fights hand-to-hand with No-Holds Zabzhar and has no unique dialogue.
Bashgara is an Orsimer bodyguard for Ras'jaba residing in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr.

Belisarius Arius is an Imperial assassin and Speaker for the Dark Brotherhood. He spends most of his time doing administrative duties within the Brotherhood. When other members of the Black Hand were systematically murdered, he and the remaining three members mutilated Lucien Lachance as they thought he was the traitor. He was murdered by Mathieu Bellamont, the real traitor in The Night Mother's Crypt, in the year 3E 433.

Batul gra-Sharob is an Orsimer who has fled from Kvatch. Along with all the other refugees, she can be found at the Kvatch: Refugee Camp. Like most of Kvatch, she was caught completely unaware by the Daedra attack on the city. Upon awakening to screaming and fire, she fled the city but her friends were not so lucky. She has developed a shop consisting primarily of weapons she retained when escaping Kvatch, and also provides repairs. She is a Master in Mercantile, indicating she owned a major business before Kvatch's destruction.

Belisarius is a male Imperial living in Cloud Ruler Temple, north of Bruma. Belisarius is a member of the Blades, a group dedicated to protecting the Emperor. He can be found doing the night shift and in the west wing during the day.
Bejeen is an Argonian living in Leyawiin. She is Weebam-Na's wife and plays a minor role in the Daedric Shrine quest at the Shrine of Nocturnal.

Beewos is an Argonian follower of the Daedric Prince Sheogorath. Like the other Madgod followers, she can be found near the Shrine of Sheogorath and cares little for clothing. She wears only a leather helmet and a pair of quilted shoes. She also carries an iron dagger and a small amount of gold.
Bazur gro-Gharz is an Orc that lives in Cheydinhal. He has a few bottles of Skooma in his house. When not at his house, Bazur can be found either visiting Newlands Lodge or Borba's Goods and Stores.
Baurion is a Breton ostler who can be found at the Roxey Inn.
Beatrice Gene is a Breton commoner who works as a servant at Anvil Castle.
Beirir is a Nord savant and member of the Ulfgar clan living peacefully side by side with the Dalvilu clan their home in the settlement of Bleaker's Way, north of the Imperial City.
Bato Veranius is a Nord smuggler who resides in the Dwemer Ruins of Arkngthand.
Belethor is a Breton in who owns the Belethor's General Goods shop in the city of Whiterun.
Beem-Ja is an Argonian Sorcerer encountered near Ironbind Barrow, along with his fellow companion, Salma.
Beirand is a Nord blacksmith running the Solitude Blacksmith in Solitude. He is the husband of Sayma, who owns Bits and Pieces, and the father of Kayd.

Batum gra-Bar was an Orsimer Hunter of Hircine sent to kill Sinding, but was killed by her intended target instead. Her corpse can be found inside Bloated Man's Grotto, next to J'Kier, a dying Khajiit.
Bat gro-Orkul was an Orsimer smith and resident of the ruined city of Vitharn, which was overrun by its own brethren centuries ago.
Beelei is an Argonian commoner who resides in her home within the settlement of Deepwallow in the Shivering Isles.
Belchimac is a Breton miner who resides in Karthwasten. He works inside Sanuarach Mine and resides in the Karthwasten Miner's Barracks.
Bedenea Nethan is a Dunmer who may be found in Minabi. She is hostile towards Nerevarine on sight.
Beldrose Dralor is a Dunmer noble and member of House Redoran who resides in the Redoran Vaults of Vivec, Redoran Canton.
Beleru Hledri is a Dunmer thief and a member of a bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold Andasreth. She can be found on the upper level and is hostile.
Beech was a member of Moraelyn's Companions sometime during the First Era. He was a Bosmer, and a brother of Willow.
Bauril is a Bosmer Barbarian and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. She is located on the bottom level of the Hlormaren Keep.
Beleval is Bosmer bandit, vampire hunter and member of the Dawnguard. She is available as a follower to the Dragonborn. She is the only Bosmer who joins the Dawnguard.

Beela-Eeto was an Argonian soldier serving in the Ebonheart Pact in 2E 583. At some point during the Alliance War, Beela-Eeto was stationed in the Deshaan region on the Morrowind/Black Marsh border. While there, he was issued a set of Dunmer traditional armor, which ill-fit him.
Bazgulub gro-Ulfish is an Orsimer Barbarian, and slaver residing in the cave of Assarnud. He will be hostile towards the Nerevarine on sight. He has the key to Slave's Bracers inside Assarnud.
Beekatan is an Argonian slave residing in Minabi Bandit Lair.
Belene Yvienne is a Breton spellsword, and a member of House Telvanni residing in the first room of Shishara.

Battlereeve Urcelmo is the Altmer leader of the First Auridon Marines and Eagle's Talons in who serves as the escort/bodyguard for Queen Ayrenn as she travels through the nations of the Aldmeri Dominion.
Beggar Matthew is a Breton who sleeps rough in the city Daggerfall in Glenumbra.
Begnaud is a Breton chef residing in the city of Aldcroft, Glenumbra. He has a stall in the Dockside Green market, where he sells food items that he has presumably cooked or baked.
Belane is a Bosmer who resides in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard.
Bedyni the Artificer is a Dunmer found in the ruins of Mzithumz, where she is conducting researchs on the dwarven spiders there.
Belderi Llenim is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. She is the armsman of their branch in Mournhold.
Battlemage Lexi is a Breton mage who resides in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. She can be found in the Lion Guard camp in town.
Bedastair is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. He's found outside Alcaire Keep, cleaning the street.
Bastien Etanne is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He's found fishing south of the city.
Beek-Ja is an Argonian who resides at The Fish Stink in Davon's Watch in the region of Stonefalls.
Belera Fanim is a Dunmer found outside the Tribunal Temple in Mournhold.
Beatrice is one of Governor Vinticae's four champions. She is typically found southwest of Slipneck Fjord 2.
Bazbava is a Redguard residing in the Sentinel Outlaws Refuge, in the city of Sentinel.
Beldun Andas is a Dunmer beggar residing in Quarantine Serk.
Bastibien Renaudin is a Breton bard first found playing at the Dead Wolf Inn in Shornhelm. After regaining control of Northpoint, he is seen playing at The Sloshing Tankard.
Bataba is a Khajiit residing in Vulkwasten. She is found parousing the wares of the Mystic Moons Imports.
Bathed-in-Steel is an Argonian armorer and owner of the shop named after her, in Stormhold. She is the author of Crafting Motif 44: Silken Ring Style.
Battlemage Papus is an Imperial member of the Seventh Legion found in the Bangkorai Garrison.
Baxard is a Nord who was slain by the Worm Cult. His corpse can be found at Treva's Farm.
Beaubel Augier is a Breton merchant and owner of Augier's Fine Wares, in Shinji's Scarp.
Beaucourt Genin is a Breton residing in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra.
Bedena Tenim is a Dunmer found sweeping at the docks in Shad Astula.
Beekaw is an Argonian merchant and part of the group of outlaws found underneath the Elden Root.
Beela is an Argonian member of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Riften.
Beem-Tei is an Argonian mystic of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Riften.
Bekka Owlcloak is a Nord patron of the Crossroads Tavern, in Belkarth.
Belene Ancois is a Breton found in Koeglin Village. She can be found in her home performing household tasks, such as sharpening knives and sweeping.
Belgrod Sternblade is a Nord warrior found at the markets in Nimalten.
Belaraam is a senche-tiger found in Jathsogur in Malabal Tor, Valenwood. It is Chief Nagoth's pet.
Beast Handler Mahei-Ma is an Argonian member of the Jackdaw Pirates involved in the attack on the city of Haven.
Behelir is a Bosmer member of the Mages Guild found in the Reliquary of Stars.
Bayya is a Khajiit member of the Stonefire Cult. She infiltrated the Mages Guild branch in Dune.
Chief Bazrag gro-Fharun is the Orcish chief of Clan Fharun, residing in Fharun Stronghold. He is a devout worshiper of Malacath, and was once a close friend of King Kurog.
Batorabesh is an Orsimer brewer found in the Greedy Gut in the city of Orsinium.
Belenius Lentinus is a Imperial residing in Abah's Landing. He is a guard under the employ of Lady Sulima at her mansion.
Batara is an Orsimer who resides in Klang Manor. She has no unique dialogue.
Bekhwug is an Orsimer residing in Praldyn's Home in the city of Wayrest. He has no unique dialogue.
Baxlof is a Nord fisherman found walking around the docks in Anvil, The Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.
Beek-Metaku is an Argonian found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast. He has no unique dialogue.
Battlereeve Alduril is a high-ranking member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is leading the charge of the Dominion operation against the Sea Vipers of Tempest Island.
Beek-Ru is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak.
Beexutl is an Argonian found inside Silver-Claw's Warehouse in Abah's Landing.
Bastibien Dencent is a Breton residing in Evermore. He can be seen in the central square occasionally talking to Zizou Douar.
Beline is a Breton vampire employed by House Montclair. She is part of the trio of bosses found within Hildune's Secret Refuge.
Bekwine Thon is a female Nord farmer in who resides in Bleakrock Village on Bleakrock Isle.
Belenius Pelius is an Imperial who can be found in Anvil docks. He cannot be interacted with.
Beeheisei is an Argonian laborer sitting against a wall in Pilgrim's Approach in Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Beifja is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Beleru Omoril is a Dunmer residing in the Hall of Justice within the Temple Canton in Vivec City.
Beetle Fabricant is an assassin beetle shaped fabricant that appears in .

Batasha is an Orsimer found beside the road with her backpack and brew at one of her possible locations in Wrothgar. She can grant Batasha's Brew effect. She is also found at Paragon's Remembrance, having been kidnapped by the Vosh Rakh.
Battlereeve Farwenya is an Altmer who can be found in a vanguard camp near Sea Keep in Summerset.
Begok is an Orsimer guild trader found in the Rimmen Outlaws Refuge in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. He runs the Hidden Treasures stall.
Belegond is a Bosmer residing at a shrine of Mara in Valenwood. He is encountered alongside Aerwean.
Beek-Shei is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe residing in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Beehuna is an Argonian member of the Root-House Tribe found at the Glade of Chimes in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Baxold is a Nord residing in the Solitude Mages Guild in Solitude.

Beckoner Morvayn is a Dunmer member of the Sixth House. He can be found in the northwestern part of the Cavern of Kogoruhn of the Forgotten Wastes. He jumps down from the ledge after the members of the Sixth House below are killed.
Belene was a princess of Kvatch, and the daughter of King Justinius. She became the wife of Rislav Larich, who would later be known as Rislav the Righteous.
Bevene Releth is a Dunmer Merchants found in Ald'ruhn. She has a shop where she sells clothes to the populace. Ienas Sarandas owes her and several other merchants in Ald'ruhn a huge amount of money.

Bendu Olo was the Cyrodilic king of Anvil during the First Era and the Baron-Admiral of the All Flags Navy who led the campaign to wipe out the Sload from the coral kingdom of Thras in 1E 2200 after the Thrassian Plague. The All Flags Navy consisted of forces from the sources of the Colovian Estates, Nibenay Valley, Summerset Isles, Hammerfell, and likely High Rock as well. Following the sinking of Thras, he returned to his home city and began converting the then Anvil Fortress into the Castle Anvil. It is possible that Bendu Olo is in someway related to Olaj Olo, the supposed Nordic demi-god of mead, who fought alongside Ysgramor's Five Hundred Companions, and Rusio Olo, a knight of the Ord
Berich Inian is an Imperial soldier in the Kvatch guard. He is encountered during the quest "Find the Heir," inside the Chapel of Akatosh.

Beyte Fyr is a Dunmer spellsword who resides in Tel Fyr, Morrowind. One of the four "daughters" of Divayth Fyr, she was created by him, as a "side benefit of the researches into corprus disease." She now exists solely to serve her master, Divayth Fyr, and takes care of the cooking and the cleaning. She is related to Alfe, Delte, and Uupse.

Bervaso Thenim is a Dunmer Apothecary at the Molag Mar Temple in the Molag Amur region of Morrowind. He is a novice member of the Tribunal Temple, and trades in alchemy apparatuses, ingredients, and potions. Bervaso wears expensive clothing, wields a Steel Staff of Peace, and carries a copy of 36 Lessons of Vivec, Sermon 2, an alchemy skill book. He is not involved in any quests.

Biene Amelion is a resident of the settlement of Water's Edge. Her father left, leaving her with his gambling debts. She lives alone in their house. She is killed during the Fighters Guild quest "Infiltration," however, until that point she is considered essential by the game.

Big Head is an Argonian savant of the Bliss province of New Sheoth. He has made his way to the Shivering Isles from Morrowind. He seems to have a strange obsession with forks, as his house is filled with them and he frequently talks about them.
Bernadette Peneles is a resident of Skingrad. She works in Tamika's Vineyards, and owns a house in the city. Bernadette is one of the three people Glarthir suspects is spying on him.

Beran Sintav is one of four nephews of Iniel Sintav living in their house in the Elven Gardens District of the Imperial City. The fourth brother, Cyronin Sintav, has had a dispute with Helvo Atius, who lives in the Imperial City's Talos Plaza District, that has caused bad blood between the Sintav and Atius clans.
Benunius Agrudilius is an Imperial publican who resides in the Lucky Lockup in Balmora.

Belmyne Dreleth is a demented Dunmer battlemage encountered when the Hero arrives at the Strange Door on the island in the middle of the Niben Bay. He is swiftly killed by Gaius Prentus or the Hero if they choose to intervene.
Benor is a Nord in who lives in Morthal. He applied for guard duty once, but for unknown reasons he has not been accepted. He now helps the guard in any way he can.
Bergritte Battle-Born is an elderly Nord in who resides in the city of Whiterun.
Belrand is a Nord mercenary and a potential follower who can be found in the Winking Skeever in Solitude.

Bersi Honey-Hand is the proprietor of The Pawned Prawn, a general goods store located in Riften. He is known for being charitable, and his wife Drifa often mentions that she wishes he would be more concerned with his own needs than the needs of others.

Betrid Silver-Blood is a Nord who lives in Markarth and is the wife to Thonar Silver-Blood. Betrid is proud and will brag about her husband's importance, openly states that she married him for money and isn't ashamed to admit it, and how much weight her family bears in Markarth. She also tends to point out the vast property of the family.
Bendt is an elderly Nord chef at the Bards College in Solitude.
Big Helende is an Altmer and a member of the Thieves Guild in who resides in Dirty Muriel's Cornerclub, Sadrith Mora.
Bernadette Bantien was a Breton mage and a scholar of the College of Winterhold. Bernadette was also a writter, having written the book Amongst the Draugr.
Bern is a dead miner whose remains can be found in Lost Prospect Mine.
Benudni Ilurnubishpal is a Dunmer Mabrigash who resides in the Grazelands of Vvardenfell.
Berapli Ashumallit is a Dunmer Mabrigash who resides in the Ashlands of Vvardenfell.
Beraren Sadri is a Dunmer monk who resides in Holamayan Monastery in Morrowind. He is a member of the Dissident Priests.
Berel Sala is a Dunmer Ordinator and member of the Tribunal Temple, who resides in the Vivec, Temple Canton inside the Justice Offices. He is Grandmaster and chief of Ordinators on Vvardenfell.
Bervyn Lleryn is a Dunmer Trader residing in Vivec City. He is a trader at St. Olms Waistworks.
Bethes Sarothril is a Dunmer witchhunter residing outside of Ald Daedroth. He can be found patrolling the area up the hill from, and almost behind, the uppermost section of the ruins.
Bildren Areleth is a Dunmer who resides in Tel Aruhn. He can be found inside his apothecary shop.
Bilos Andrethi is a Dunmer Rogue, and slaver who resides in the stronghold of Hlormaren. He is located on the bottom level of Hlormaren's keep.
Berengeval is a Bosmer who resides in Tel Naga, General Quarters.
Berwen is a Bosmer residing in Tel Mora. She owns a general goods store there.
Benkum is a Nord sailor who is met at the Water Stone along with his fellow shipmates Hjalfar, Liesl, and Palevius Lex.
Bilgemuck is a unique bristleback in . He belongs to the Rieklings of Thirsk Mead Hall, and runs away from the Rieklings when they accidentally scare him off.
Bels Uvenim is a Dunmer noble residing in the Temple Courtyard in Mournhold.
Bhosek the Bloody is a Redguard and the self-appointed Headman of Stros M'Kai. He serves as the region's main antagonist.

Bill Nighy (born William Francis Nighy) is an award-winning English actor who provided the voice for High King Emeric in . Some of his other work includes Davy Jones in the Pirates of the Caribbean movies, Viktor in the Underworld movie series, as well as minor parts in franchises such as Doctor Who and Harry Potter. __NOTOC__

Belknar is a Nord ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed and the ghosts have returned. He can be found kneeling before Skavwulf the Maul with Ogmir and Hrorleid.
Bernard Redain is a Breton who resides in Deleyn's Mill, Glenumbra, in . He is related to Catherine Redain and Theo Redain.
Bhagrun gro-Dunk is an Orsimer in the camp in Glenumbra Moors, High Rock. He is voiced by Fred Tatasciore.
Berjac Pajaud is a Breton commoner who resides in the city of Daggerfall. He can be found in the market, visiting the various merchants.
Bera Moorsmith is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild in who acts as a messenger to inform the Vestige of various events regarding the Fighters Guild.
Benae Andoril is a Dunmer priestess found inside the Tribunal Temple of Mournhold.
Bethany LeBlanc is a Breton who is found in Tangle Rock in Glenumbra. She has been kidnapped by cultists.
Bertrand Gane is a Breton residing in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He is found in his house with an Orsimer named Rognar. The house is located in the northern part of the city, near The Rosy Lion.
Benoit Gette is a Breton residing at the Wyrd Tree, Glenumbra. He arrives at the tree and starts selling his wares there after the quests involving the tree have been completed.
Bethany Frernele is a Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found listening to one of the guards holding a speech, halfway down to Daggerfall Docks.

Bertran Oscent is a Breton residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. His wife, Margot, is very worried as her son is missing, but he does not seem to be upset about it. He is standing outside their home near the docks.
Bernadette is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, located inside the Old Goat Inn.
Benry Claverie is a Breton residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. He's found in the local Mages Guild.
Berantin is a Khajiit residing in Cat's Eye Quay in Mistral. He was attacked by Sea Vipers and watched his neighbors die in front of him.

Beredalmo the Signifier, also known as Beredalmo Direnni, is an author and member of the Direnni Clan. He was considered the greatest expert on Ayleids during the Second Era. He resided in the Tourmaline Steeple of the Direnni Tower, caring for Heron Direnni during the day and translating Ayleid tomes in the Direnni library at night. Morian Zenas published a work titled "Commentaries on Beredalmo" in reference to Beredalmo the Signifier.
Biiril is a Dunmer skooma addict residing in Ebonheart. He was talked into attempting to poison the Hist tree found in the Argonian quarters in the city by Rhavil Urano.
Belosi Hlaalu is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu residing in Mournhold.
Benus Girith is a Dunmer weaponsmith. He works at the Artisans Craftworks in Mournhold.
Berala Thirdborn is a Nord laborer found at the Guild Plaza near the southwestern gate of Mournhold.
Berra Coldmoon is a Nord laborer located near the Girvu Stables in Mournhold.

Betina Volek is a Dunmer residing in Mournhold. She is a descendant of a family that once owned slaves, and thus, is targeted by former Argonian slaves found in the city. If the player chooses to save her life, she reveals that she intends to resume her family's slaving practices once the Ebonheart Pact ends.
Bidia Redoran is a Dunmer noble of House Redoran residing in Mournhold.
Benjamund Holette is a Breton armorer residing in the city of Evermore. He can be found at his shop, Ten Mountains Armory, selling his wares.
Benizir is a Redguard residing in the city of Hallin's Stand.
Belos Adrys is a Dunmer patron of the Brooding Elf Inn in Quarantine Serk.
Bili Hlan is a Dunmer residing in her house in Quarantine Serk.
Belvin Redoran is a Dunmer armsman of the Fighters Guild in Fort Amol.
Belvo is a Dunmer found screaming over his lost report by a table in the ponds of Shad Astula.
Bemfola Songbird is a Nord patron of Deldwine's Inn, in Fort Amol.
Bends-Iron is a blacksmith first found in his shop, Stormhold Forges, in Stormhold. He is later found in the Hollow City, in Coldharbour, where he runs the Cold Iron Forge.
Bendyni Nelvani is a Dunmer merchant and a member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed in Fort Virak.
Benjamyn Derre is a Breton tailor and owner of Magical Weavings, in Shinji's Scarp.
Ber-Jaseen is an Argonian residing in the city of Riften, The Rift.
Berela Ralen is a Dunmer patron of The Watch House in Davon's Watch.
Beritta Crow-Song is a Nord bard playing at the Caravan Company Depot, in Dragonstar. She cannot be interacted with.
Bermund is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. He is part of the forces stationed in the Vernim Woods.
Bernamund Agnan is a Breton laborer residing in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He is typically found listening to a speech by Sir Khnanya at-Salan, near the Daggerfall Docks.
Bernt the Brittle is a Nord in found at The Everfull Flagon in Coldharbour.
Beron Telvanni is a Dunmer member of House Telvanni trying to lift the curse lingering in the Heimlyn Keep.
Berriza is a Khajiit merchant in who sells her wares at her stall, Mystic Moons Imports, in Vulkwasten.
Bewlus is a Argonian residing in the Dormitory in Shad Astula.
Beyte Damori is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed in Fort Arand.
Bezera is a Khajiit found at the Windcatcher Plantation on Khenarthi's Roost.
Bezhefah is a Redguard working at The Run Inn, in Fell's Run.
